record.question: You have been working in another State for over five years in a huge multinational corporation as one of the young managers. You recently got through a competitive examination and found yourself moving back home and is posted as a Managing Director of a corporation of public sector undertaking. You find that the working pace is very slow unlike the work culture you were accustomed to in your earlier job. The staff members are not committed and seems to be working in slow motion where everybody comes in late and goes home early and does not seem to care about the quantity or the quality of the products and services of the corporation you are now leading. With respect to work culture, quality of service delivery, and uitilization of public funds, how would you proceed to improve this corporation you are now heading as its Managing Director?
